name: membrane associated ring-CH-type finger 10

function.text: MARCHF10 is the approved symbol for membrane associated ring-CH-type finger 10. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ubiquitin protein ligase activity; zinc ion binding; protein ubiquitination.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: MARCHF10 encodes membrane associated ring-CH-type finger 10. E3 ubiquitin ligases accept ubiquitin from an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme in the form of a thioester and then directly transfer the ubiquitin to targeted substrates.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MARCHF10 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.
